title: 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' trailer teases Haymitch's defiance against the Capitol
summary: Set 24 years before The Hunger Games , the film follows 16-year-old Haymitch Abernathy, played by Joseph Zada, as he competes in the 50th Hunger Games, or the Second Quarter Quell.
